description: Convert zaps from a Zapier export (Settings → Security and data → Download my Zap workflows; one JSON file holds all zaps) into n8n workflows. Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere. Writes one <zap title>.n8n.json plus a Markdown and JSON report per zap to outputDir, and returns the reports: totals, every step with its n8n node and status, suggestions for the steps to finish by hand, and the file paths. When the export holds many zaps, call list_zaps first and pass the chosen titles or ids in "zaps". For Make blueprints use convert_make instead.

json.description: The full contents of the exported file, when the user pasted or attached it instead of giving a path. Give either path or json, not both.

outputDir.description: Folder to write the results to; created if missing; existing files are kept and the new ones get " (2)", " (3)"… in their name. Default: Documents/migrate-to-n8n in the home folder.

path.description: Absolute path of the exported file on this computer (~ is the home folder). Give either path or json, not both.

zaps.description: Titles or ids of the zaps to convert, as list_zaps shows them; titles match without regard to case. Leave out to convert every zap in the export.

name: convert_zapier
title: Convert Zapier zaps to n8n
